title: Sky Block #1
author: requiem.moe
body: Starting a solo playthrough today, I've always been sorta unable to play alone. Idk why, but I will try to make this a sorta mini series for those who actually view the blog, so its not all just me rambling about new versions or my mental health. In that aspect, I do believe this might help me stay in a routine sorta, I gotta teach myself to want to do stuff again... MDD is a pain. Will someone take my anhedonia away?
